usage: hermes update [-h] [--gateway] [--yes] [--keep-stash] [--check]
                     [--branch BRANCH] [--channel CHANNEL]
                     [--set-channel CHANNEL] [--install-id]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --yes                 Accept every prompt
  --keep-stash          Keep the stash
  --check               Check for updates without applying them
  --branch BRANCH       Update from this branch
  --channel CHANNEL     Update from this channel for this run only
  --set-channel CHANNEL
                        Persist the update channel for this install
  --install-id          Print this install's id and exit
